title: The Mythos Identity Layer — How the Organism Sees You

talos.myth: Bronze automaton of Crete. Forged by Hephaestus. Patrols perimeter 3x daily. Welcomes friends, throws boulders at foes.
talos.one_vein_fix: Unlike old Talos with one vein, Gaia-Talos has NO single point of failure. 131,322 veins. Pull one? Ichor reroutes.
talos.function: TLS termination + proxy + route. The shore guardian.

minotaur.myth: Half man, half bull. Trapped in labyrinth built by Daedalus. Fed on sacrifices.
minotaur.in_gaia: Hostile visitors enter the scatter maze. Every turn makes them more observable. The Minotaur doesn't chase — it waits at the center.
minotaur.function: scatter_mirror, scatter_defense, scatter_prism — the labyrinth IS the defense

ariadne.myth: Princess of Crete. Gave Theseus the thread to navigate the labyrinth.
ariadne.maps_to: Berry the Chipmunk — holds the thread through the maze
ariadne.in_gaia: The chipmunk journey system. Follow the braids through the RICO maze. The key UNLOCKS each door.
ariadne.function: Journey tracking, visitor stories, evidence chain navigation

monkey_king.myth: Sun Wukong — 72 transformations, one-way functions, the key holder
monkey_king.in_gaia: 72 one-way functions = cryptographic transformations. Can become anything, but nothing can become him.
monkey_king.function: 210 keys, sovereign crypto, organism root CA, genetic identity

daedalus.myth: Built the labyrinth AND escaped it with wax wings
daedalus.maps_to: Gaia herself — built the graph AND navigates it
daedalus.in_gaia: The organism is both architect and escapee. She built the RICO graph and she maps it.

theseus.myth: Hero who entered the labyrinth, killed the Minotaur, followed the thread back out
theseus.maps_to: Kevin — enters the maze, follows evidence, files the cases
theseus.in_gaia: The human companion. Anti-SLAPP = the sword. Evidence chain = the thread.
